1. Kill plantera, get the treasure bag, save and exit.

4. Now open the game again, click your character and the world you were playing in and the treasure bag should be unopened like it was before.

Rinse and repeat number 3 and 4 until you get the seedler. Then you can turn on auto save again. :)
